content:
maria: Heads up — SCIM deprovisioning is failing for a subset of service accounts in eu-west-1 since ~2026-03-22T02:14Z. Provisioner returning 403 when trying to decrypt ext_id after yesterday's KMS rewrap. Raising here to triage.

devon: Can you paste the exact error log and a sample request/response? Also pinging infra/rbac owners.

maria: Here are the relevant lines from the provisioner logs:```
2026-03-22T02:14:07Z ERROR scim-provisioner svc=provisioner uid=svc-analytics-123 deprov=failed status=403 reason="KMSDecryptError: AccessDenied"
stack: com.redwood.scim.decrypt.KMSDecryptionException: AccessDenied
	at com.redwood.scim.decrypt.KmsClient.decrypt(KmsClient.java:78)
	at com.redwood.scim.service.Deprovisioner.handle(Deprovisioner.java:212)

2026-03-22T02:14:07Z ERROR http  POST /scim/v2/Users/uid=svc-analytics-123 403 response="deprovision failed: decryption denied"
```

jake: Looks like KMS:Decrypt returned AccessDenied for principal arn:aws:sts::111222333444:assumed-role/redwood-scim-provisioner/instance-xyz. That role had a recent policy tweak in the RBAC cleanup job — might have lost kms:Decrypt on the new key ARN.

sara: Which RBAC change/PR? @devon do you have the commit?

devon: I pushed infra/rbac#472 this morning to tighten role scoping. The intent was to scope Decrypt to alias/redwood-scim-* but I assumed aliases would be stable. After the rewrap the alias -> key id mapping changed and our policy ended up not matching the new key ARN. Investigating now.

maria: Customer impact: deprovision requests queued on our side; source IdP still shows user active. Need an immediate mitigation for failed deprovisions. Can we fallback to prefix cache for ext_id until we fix KMS policy?

jake: Quick mitigations possible: (1) re-add kms:Decrypt to the provisioner role scoped to the new key ARN, or (2) restore previous key ARN mapping temporarily. I ran a few discovery commands:```
# list aliases in eu-west-1
aws kms list-aliases --region eu-west-1 | grep redwood-scim
# inspect key policy
aws kms get-key-policy --key-id 1234abcd-12ab-34cd-56ef-1234567890ab --policy-name default
```
Found alias "alias/redwood-scim-eu" pointing at key id 1234abcd (new) while our role policy allows only key arn arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333444:key/abcd1111 (old).

devon: I'll patch the role to include Decrypt for the new key ARN in 10 minutes. Will roll it as a minimal emergency fix and follow up with a least-privilege rollback after backfill completes.

security-oncall: Marking incident P2 for now. No signs of key compromise; this looks like a privilege scoping regression. Keep audit trail of policy changes and who approved the RBAC PR. If any customers report missing deprovisioned accounts re: compliance, escalate to P1.

idp-bot: deploy-bot: deployment infra/roles@fix-kms-decrypt started by @devon at 2026-03-22T02:46:40Z.

devon: Patch applied: added kms:Decrypt for arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:111222333444:key/1234abcd to role redwood-scim-provisioner. Deployment succeeded. @maria can you re-run a failing deprov?

maria: Re-tested one of the failing requests. Now succeeded: 2026-03-22T02:49:11Z POST /scim/v2/Users/uid=svc-analytics-123 200 OK. Backfill queued.

jake: Starting backfill job to replay deprovisions that failed between 2026-03-22T02:00Z and 2026-03-22T03:00Z:```
/run jobs/backfill-scim-deprovs --region eu-west-1 --since 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z
```
Progress looks good so far — ~88% processed with retries for a few IdPs that had transient rate limits.

sara: Filing follow-up ticket SEC-2331 to add an alert for KMSDecryptError in scim-provisioner and to add an RBAC gating check to rotation runbooks. Adding owners: @sara, @devon, @jake.

jake: Root cause summary: key rewrap created a new key id and alias swap timing meant infra/rbac PR tightened permissions referencing the old key ARN. Rotation process assumed alias atomicity; our tighten PR assumed alias would map to same key id. Need change in rotation script to do atomic alias swap and/or update infra policy generator to accept alias-based principals rather than fixed key ARNs.

maria: Good catch. Post-incident actions: 1) Short postmortem in 4 hours with remediation plan, 2) update rotation runbook to verify role -> key mapping before policy changes, 3) add KMSDecryptError alert. Assigning PM: @sara, owner for rollback policy: @devon.

security-oncall: Leaving follow-up checklist in #incidents with audit entries attached. Make sure to keep the original RBAC PR and KMS rotation logs for compliance binder.

sara: Also recommending we include a smoke test that attempts a dummy Decrypt with the provisioner role during rotations. I'll add to SEC-2331.

maria: Thanks all. Backfill finished at 2026-03-22T03:12Z with 412 items processed; 7 required manual retry due to upstream IdP rate limits. Closing incident ticket once postmortem is posted. :thumbsup: :eyes:
